rules.rule: Applicant must be a registered business, an international education and training provider, a not-for-profit incorporated organisation, or a student or community group with an auspicing body.

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: applicant.type in allowed_applicant_types; AI confirms the description supports the stated type
rules.plain_english_reason: Only certain types of applicant can receive this grant. We could not confirm that {applicant_name} is one of them. Tell us which type you are (for example, a not-for-profit incorporated association) and give your registration details.

rules.rule: A registered business, company or incorporated association must have an ABN. If it has no ABN, it must show support from an auspicing body.

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: if applicant.type in {registered_business, nfp_incorporated}: applicant.abn present OR auspicing_body.name present
rules.plain_english_reason: Your application did not include an ABN or an auspicing body. Please add your ABN, or the name of the organisation that will auspice your grant.

rules.rule: A student or community group must apply with an auspicing body (a not-for-profit organisation that takes legal and financial responsibility for the grant).

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: if applicant.type == student_or_community_group: auspicing_body.name present AND auspicing_body.confirmed == true
rules.evidence_needed: Named auspicing body and confirmation it has agreed
rules.plain_english_reason: Student and community groups need an auspicing body. Your application does not name one that has agreed to take on the grant. Please name the organisation and include its confirmation.

rules.rule: The applicant must be in the NT, or (if not registered in the NT) the event must directly benefit international students living in the NT.

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round
source.section: Who can apply > Businesses outside of the NT; What can't be funded

rules.check: applicant.nt_based == true OR evidence that the activity directly benefits international students living in the NT
rules.evidence_needed: Applicant location; where the event happens and who it serves
rules.plain_english_reason: This grant is for activities that help international students living in the Northern Territory. We could not confirm this from your application. Tell us where the event will happen and who it is for.

rules.rule: The applicant must not have outstanding acquittals or compliance issues with the Department of Trade, Business and Asian Relations (unless Study NT approved a variation or extension).

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: Officer checks department records. NOT assessed from the application text.
rules.plain_english_reason: Our records show an earlier grant from Study NT has not been fully reported on (acquitted). We can consider a new grant once that report is submitted.

rules.rule: Events and activities must take place between 1 July 2024 and 1 June 2025.

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: round.window_start <= project.start_date AND project.end_date <= round.window_end
rules.plain_english_reason: Events for this round must happen between 1 July 2024 and 1 June 2025. Your event dates ({start_date} to {end_date}) are outside this period.

rules.rule: The event must be available to all international students, or to students from at least 3 international education or training providers.

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: AI finds text showing open to all international students OR names >= 3 providers whose students can attend
rules.plain_english_reason: Your event must be open to all international students, or to students from at least three different education providers. Your application does not show this yet. Tell us who can attend, or list the providers whose students are invited.

rules.rule: Activities that started before the application is approved cannot be funded.

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: project.start_date > round.earliest_approval_date
rules.plain_english_reason: We cannot fund activities that start before a grant is approved. Your activity starts on {start_date}, before the earliest approval date of {earliest_approval_date}.

rules.rule: The event or activity must focus on the wellbeing of international students.

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: AI quotes evidence of wellbeing focus; officer decides
rules.evidence_needed: Project description; how it supports wellbeing
rules.plain_english_reason: This grant only funds activities focused on the wellbeing of international students. From your application, the main purpose of the activity appears to be {stated_purpose}. If wellbeing is a key goal, please explain how the activity supports it.

rules.rule: The event must meet the objectives of the grant: (a) high-quality activities that promote student wellbeing; (b) social connections and belonging to the NT; (c) employment opportunities while studying or post-study; (d) community understanding of the value international students bring to the NT; (e) tools and strategies to manage mental health and physical safety.

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round
source.section: Grants for international student wellbeing (intro); What can't be funded

rules.check: AI maps applicant text to each objective (a)-(e); officer judges whether objectives are addressed
rules.plain_english_reason: Your application needs to show how the activity meets at least one of the grant's goals. We could not see a clear link to {objective}. Tell us what participants will gain from the activity.

rules.rule: The application must be complete.

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: All required fields present and non-empty: applicant.name, applicant.type, project.title, project.description, project.start_date, project.end_date, project.who_can_attend, budget (>=1 line)
rules.plain_english_reason: Your application is missing: {missing_fields}. Please add these so we can assess it.

rules.rule: The grant amount requested must not exceed $10,000.

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: total_requested <= 10000
rules.plain_english_reason: You asked for ${total_requested}. The most this grant can provide is $10,000.

rules.rule: Budget line items must add up to the total amount requested. (Tool consistency check: not a published rule.)

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: abs(sum(budget.amount) - total_requested) < 0.01
rules.plain_english_reason: Your budget items add up to ${budget_sum}, but you requested ${total_requested}. Please check your budget so the totals match.

rules.rule: Travel costs must not exceed 50% of the total grant.

source.document: Grants for international student wellbeing (NT.GOV.AU), 2024-25 round

rules.check: sum(budget[category==travel]) <= 0.50 * total_requested
rules.plain_english_reason: Your budget asks for ${amount} for travel. The limit is 50% of the grant (${limit}).

rules.rule: Facilitator or consultant fees must not exceed 50% of the total grant.

rules.plain_english_reason: Your budget asks for ${amount} for facilitators or consultants. The limit is 50% of the grant (${limit}).

rules.rule: Catering costs must not exceed 25% of the total grant.
